Olivia Chen: Day 3 check-in — quick status + blockers
Olivia Chen: What I did: finished local dev env, ran frontend + backend locally, loaded seed data, and built the sample image.
Olivia Chen: Blockers: GitLab CI can't push to the internal container registry from my runner job. I get `fatal: could not read Username for 'https://gitlab.redwood.com': No such device or address` when the CI tries to docker login. Local `docker login` with my user works.
Olivia Chen: Also blocked on namespace for my feature branch deployment — can't create k8s namespace in dev cluster (RBAC denied).
Olivia Chen: Today: ask infra for registry creds for CI, get namespace created or add me to the team, and ping for a quick PR review if possible (PR !342).
Samir Patel: hey @Olivia — welcome! for the CI issue, do you have a project deploy token configured or are you using personal creds in the job?
Olivia Chen: Using the project runner config from the quickstart. I didn't set up a deploy token — the job expects `CI_REGISTRY_USER` + `CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD`, but those envs are empty in the pipeline.
Samir Patel: ok that explains it. We normally use a project-deploy-token or the CI_JOB_TOKEN for internal registry pushes. @InfraBot which pattern are new projects forwarded to?
InfraBot: Scheduled response: New projects default to project-deploy-token pattern. See docs: https://docs.redwood.internal/ci/registry (access requires SSO) :gear:
Ben L: @Olivia I can create the k8s namespace for you. Which cluster and namespace name do you want?
Olivia Chen: thanks @Ben L — cluster: dev-east, namespace: olivia-feature-pt342.
Ben L: noted — I'll request the namespace and RBAC now, should be done in ~20–30m.
Olivia Chen: thanks! back to registry — @Samir is a deploy token something I can create or does it need an owner?
Samir Patel: you'll need Maintainer role on the project to create a deploy token. If you're new and don't have that yet, we can create one and add it to CI variables temporarily. @Tina can grant you Maintainer on the repo?
Tina Raj: hi @Olivia — I can give you Maintainer on the sandbox repo. Will do it in a minute, and then @Samir you can create a scoped deploy token so CI can push images.
Tina Raj: done — Olivia should have Maintainer now. Refresh and try re-running the pipeline after Samir sets the token.
Olivia Chen: confirmed I can see Maintainer role now, thanks!
Samir Patel: creating a project deploy token named `ci-registry-push-olivia` with write_registry scope and adding it as `CI_REGISTRY_USER/CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD` in masked project variables now.
Samir Patel: done and pipeline retriggered. If you still get login failures paste the job log here.
Olivia Chen: pipeline job started — the docker login step progressed further but now failing at `permission denied` when trying to push to `registry.redwood.internal/dev/olivia-feature:latest`. Full error snippet: `denied: requested access to the resource is denied`
Samir Patel: that usually means the token doesn't have permission for that project path. Did you push to a group path or project path? The token is scoped to the project only.
Olivia Chen: the CI uses path `dev/olivia-feature` under the shared group. Maybe I should push to the project's registry path instead.
Samir Patel: quick fix — I'll create a group-level deploy token set to allow writes to that group registry and update the CI var. Give me 10m.
Olivia Chen: appreciated!
InfraBot: Notice: planned node maintenance on dev-east cluster in 3 hours — small restarts possible. If you need namespace-ready before then, please let infra know.
Ben L: namespace creation ✅ — `olivia-feature-pt342` created, added you as admin in that namespace. Should be good for the k8s deploy step.
Olivia Chen: awesome — saw the namespace, thanks @Ben L. Re-ran pipeline after Samir's update and now docker push succeeded 🎉
Olivia Chen: next: PR !342 needs a quick frontend sanity review (small CSS/endpoint change). @Tina or @Ben can anyone spare 15m?
Tina Raj: I can take a look in the next hour, ping me if I'm slow.
Ben L: I'll glance after lunch — but if it's blocking deploy you can merge with two approvers for now per onboarding exception.
Olivia Chen: noted. Follow-ups: (1) confirm group-level token expiry/rotation policy, (2) add a short doc in the repo about CI registry path conventions so other new-hires avoid this. I'll draft that doc after I merge.
DevEx: Quick tip: add this snippet to your job to debug registry path issues:
```
- run: echo "REGISTRY=$CI_REGISTRY" && echo "IMAGE=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE" && docker login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" -p "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" $CI_REGISTRY
```
DevEx: also file a ticket for long-lived tokens if you need one for demos — short-lived tokens are preferred.
Olivia Chen: great, thanks everyone. Removing blocker checklist: registry push ✅, k8s namespace ✅. Next check-in tomorrow — will post PR link when it's up. :party_parrot:
